material: wurtzite GaN (4-atom cell), released by Chen, Leveillee, Van de Walle and Giustino (2025)
method: Quantum ESPRESSO 7.2 + EPW 5.7: fully relativistic norm-conserving LDA (ecutwfc 120 Ry), GW quasiparticle energies read in place of the Kohn-Sham ones (eig_read), Wannier interpolation (12 N-p Wannier functions) from 10x10x10 coarse k/q grids to 80x80x80 fine grids, polar long-range terms, adaptive smearing, Fermi-surface window 0.2 eV below the valence-band maximum, hole density 1e18 cm^-3, T = 100-500 K. Each strained state was relaxed and recomputed from scratch.
labels: Archive directory names: unstrained, compress_X%_eK and expand_X%_eK (X = 1, 2, 3; K = 1..6).
structures: cell_bohr rows are the lattice vectors a1, a2, a3 in bohr (x along a1 of the unstrained cell); atoms_crystal are [species, crystal coordinates].

bands.k_points: kgrid_crystal: the 1000 points of the 10x10x10 grid in crystal coordinates of each state's own reciprocal lattice (same order as energies_eV rows)
bands.note: bands 47-52 are the top six valence bands, 53-56 the lowest four conduction bands; energies are absolute GW quasiparticle energies in eV as archived; vbm_eV is the valence-band maximum the authors used as the Fermi-window reference

bands.returns: GW quasiparticle energies on the 10x10x10 grid for one state

mobility.returns: drift mobility tensors at every temperature in the self-energy relaxation-time approximation (serta), or the iterative Boltzmann solution together with its SERTA starting point and the solver log (ibte)
